nodes.label: CSS Custom Property Design Tokens
nodes.author: Dave
nodes.rationale: Defines light and dark mode colors once in src/app/tokens.css mapped to Tailwind v4 utilities via @theme inline so feature code never uses raw hex values or manual dark: overrides.

nodes.label: WCAG 2.1 AA Contrast & Gold Text Rule
nodes.author: Dave
nodes.norm_label: wcag 2.1 aa contrast & gold text rule
nodes.rationale: Gold (--sun) fails contrast on cream, so it is restricted to fills, markers, and outlined display titles while text on gold uses --ink; all paired tokens pass AA 4.5:1.

nodes.label: Admin UI Motif Exclusion
nodes.author: Dave
nodes.rationale: Admin and gate scanner screens keep the shared tokens and fonts but omit road, leaf, butterfly, and display title motifs to keep dense operational tables and scanner banners clear.

nodes.label: Shared Constants Single Source of Truth
nodes.norm_label: shared constants single source of truth
nodes.rationale: Avoids drift and magical hardcoded numbers between frontend forms and backend RPCs by centralizing dates, base prices, and group discount tiers in src/lib/constants.ts.

nodes.label: Atomic Concurrency & Row Level Security
nodes.rationale: Uses SELECT ... FOR UPDATE row locks in PostgreSQL RPCs (register_ycr_group) to prevent quota overselling and enforces server-side tiered pricing to prevent client-side price tampering.

nodes.label: Supabase Three-Client Pattern
nodes.rationale: Separates browser Realtime (client.ts), SSR cookie auth (server.ts), and webhook-only service role access (admin.ts) to protect privileged database mutations.

nodes.label: Server-to-Server HMAC Webhook Verification
nodes.rationale: Transitions order status to PAID and generates QR ticket codes only via POST /api/webhooks/payment/route.ts after cryptographic HMAC-SHA256 signature verification.

nodes.label: Expanding Timeline Bar & D-Day Showcase Stage
nodes.norm_label: expanding timeline bar & d-day showcase stage

nodes.label: Contract-First Parallel Development
nodes.rationale: Typed API boundaries in src/lib/contracts/ and shared constants in src/lib/constants.ts enable frontend engineers to build against mocks with zero blocking on database infrastructure.

nodes.label: Mobile-First UX Guardrail
nodes.rationale: 85%+ mobile traffic requires >=44x44px tap targets and responsive layouts from 375px viewport up to 4K displays

nodes.label: Next.js App Router RSC & Leaf Client Architecture
nodes.norm_label: next.js app router rsc & leaf client architecture
nodes.rationale: Defaults to React Server Components for data fetching, restricts 'use client' to leaf interactive components, and forbids importing admin.ts in client bundles

nodes.label: Donations Route Removal & Backend Retention
nodes.rationale: Standalone /donate UI is removed so public donations can eventually merge into the marketplace checkout flow, while backend Zod schemas and database tables are retained.

nodes.label: Conflict-Free Track Ownership (FE-1, FE-2, BE-1, BE-2)
nodes.norm_label: conflict-free track ownership (fe-1, fe-2, be-1, be-2)
nodes.rationale: Isolated tracks, branch prefixes, and strict directory boundaries per team member prevent merge conflicts during parallel AI-assisted development.

nodes.label: Shared Contracts Layer (src/lib/contracts/)
nodes.rationale: Strict contract layer between Frontend and Backend covering common, registration, timeline, marketplace, donations, payments, and admin schemas

nodes.label: Shared Constants (src/lib/constants.ts)
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth for dates (YCR_OPENS_AT, YCR_DATE_MIDNIGHT), base pricing (PRICE_WEBINAR_IDR, PRICE_YCR_INDIVIDUAL_IDR), and group discount tiers (DISCOUNT_TIER_5, DISCOUNT_TIER_10)

nodes.label: Context-Aware Paid Registration Form
nodes.rationale: Renders paid Webinar before YCR_OPENS_AT and paid YCR (Individual/Group with volume discounts) on/after YCR_OPENS_AT

nodes.label: Expanding Timeline Bar & D-Day Hero Stage
nodes.norm_label: expanding timeline bar & d-day hero stage
nodes.rationale: Pre-D-Day pinned milestone bar that automatically expands when Date.now() >= YCR_DATE_MIDNIGHT into the primary visual hero Rundown Showcase stage

nodes.label: Sunlit Highway Design System
nodes.rationale: UI components must consume CSS variables in src/app/tokens.css and follow docs/DESIGN.md (Sunlit Gold, Desert Amber, Highway Blue, Lilita One, Nunito)

nodes.label: Database RLS & Atomic Row-Lock RPCs
nodes.rationale: Requires ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY on all Supabase tables and atomic quota/registration transactions via SELECT ... FOR UPDATE to prevent overselling

nodes.label: Zod Schema & Design Token Core Rule
nodes.norm_label: zod schema & design token core rule
nodes.rationale: Enforces Zod schemas in src/lib/contracts/, generated database.types.ts, and design tokens in src/app/tokens.css across all frontend-backend boundaries

nodes.label: YCR ("The Highway") & KMK Platform
nodes.rationale: Web platform for UKM Keluarga Mahasiswa Katolik (KMK) Universitas Ciputra powering Youth Catholic Revival (YCR — "The Highway"), Webinar, Ziarah, and Baksos

nodes.label: Payment Webhook Integrity & Idempotency
nodes.rationale: Prevents frontend callbacks from marking orders PAID; requires server-to-server HMAC-SHA256 verification and idempotent 200 OK handling

nodes.label: Team & Ownership Architecture
nodes.rationale: Assigns strict directory and file scope per team member (Gee, Ken, Dave, Sean, Keane) to guarantee zero merge conflicts and preserve modularity
